subs.text: Josh — your name, your race photos, your coaching. Already built into a working platform.
A clear home for Josh Harrison and the Hybrid Hub — your headline, your menu, your brand.
The Zones: station technique, running and race-day preparation, all in one place.
Your story — 1:14 to 1:05 in one season — told on your own platform, not just in a bio.
The Hybrid Hub: 1:1 coaching, your FITR programmes and the clothing store, side by side.
Your race calendar, so athletes can line up their next start with you.
Josh says — practical race-day reminders, ready for you to review and make your own.
Ask Josh — a dedicated place for training and race-day questions.
The Warriors Wall — your community's training days and race weekends in one place. Shown here with your own shots.
Athletes send in their own photos, so the wall fills with your crew, not just your feed.
Hybrid Hub 365 gets its own space too, linked straight to your store.
Coaching has its own page, with clear routes to your existing application form and FITR programmes.
The buttons go straight to your current setup — we are not replacing how you already sell coaching.
Find a race-mate — doubles, mixed or relay partners, without hunting through comment threads.
A reason for athletes to return between coaching blocks and race weekends.
Race Tools starts with the predictor — a way to explore a target finish time.
Useful tools bring athletes back to your platform, not someone else's feed.
The split analyser puts race data and improvement opportunities in one place.
A practical starting point for a coaching conversation about where the next minutes come from.
Results board — a home for race times and progress. The demo shows how it is organised.
All eight stations: technique, pacing and coaching cues in a guide athletes can keep coming back to.
Clear sections for each station, with race imagery alongside the practical advice.
Run Zone — pacing and compromised running, because eight kilometres feels different after the sleds.
Taper Zone — the final week laid out clearly, when athletes most want reassurance.
Race calendar — a central place to plan the next event and the trip around it.
The race-trip planner — away races researched, so athletes can plan the weekend, not just the start time.
Race crew meetups — space for the community around the training, not just the training itself.
Watch — your YouTube, Instagram and Threads brought together under your own brand.
Training notes and UK HYROX news under your own brand — short, sourced, with room for your take.
Partners — codes and kit in one place, ready for the brands and codes you actually use.
Join the list — a direct route to stay in touch with people interested in your coaching.
And behind the public pages: the Desk.
A working dashboard layout for coaching income, race costs and partner activity. The figures here are demo data.
One place to review the business side alongside the athlete-facing platform.
Your coaching, useful race tools and your community — brought together as the Hybrid Hub.
Have a look around, Josh. I'd love to hear what you think.
